local_copy.anchor: Verbatim authenticated archive member, never imported

archive.anchor: PyPI SHA-256 matches saved release identity

inspected_anchors.finding: District fixability; Boolean result; functional string and stdout
GID experiment conformance uses the same exception
Checks supplied pair of models; not automatic counterfactual witness construction

supported_claims: OneLineID performs district-fixability identification on the supplied graph and query.
functional() is a string plus fixing-order diagnostics, not a portable typed numerical estimator.
The same exception can indicate invalid experimental preconditions; adapters require explicit preflight and method-specific error interpretation.
Supplied-model witness comparison is distinct from constructing witnesses or arbitrary cross-world identification.
limitations: No upstream package was installed, imported or executed. Static findings and exact authored references do not qualify native behavior, sampling inference or adapters.
